build_JTT_adaptation: build a JTT adaptation instance with lambda weight and first iteration step count
create_Adapt_subclass: create a subclass of Adapt that implements update and call methods for parameter adaptation
run_JTT_update: run the JTT update method to get adapted parameters and state at a training step
test_JTT_call: test the JTT call method to reweight loss for misclassified samples during training
review_JTT_set: review the JTT set method to manually initialize parameters and state
